newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Centro Properties plans restructure, issue.
newsitem.headline: Centro Properties plans restructure, issue.

text.p: Australian property group Centro Properties Ltd said on Wednesday it planned a major capital restructure and a A$90 million capital raising.
The restructure will involve the distribution to shareholders of units in the wholly owned Centro Property Trust, through a capital reduction, on a one-for-one basis, it said.
The units in the trust will then be "stapled" to existing shares, it said.
Subject to completion of the restructure, Centro will raise A$90 million through a non-renounceable rights issue and a placement, both underwritten by SBC Warburg.
